intro.text: The son of Highprince Roion, who became highprince after his father died at the Battle of Narak.

items.text: The youngest of the highprinces, he took his father's place after the Battle of Narak. Highprince Aladar thought him unready for the role.
When Urithiru was invaded, he was the only highprince in the tower. He gathered many Alethi officers in the map room.
